name: Sparkline SVG Generator
summary: Zero-dependency responsive SVG sparkline chart component with spline curve interpolation
description:
## Sparkline SVG Generator

Generate beautiful, responsive, self-contained SVG sparklines with smooth Catmull-Rom or cubic bezier spline interpolation, gradient area fills, min/max markers, and interactive hover dots.

### Highlights
- Pure SVG string output (usable on server or client)
- Configurable width, height, stroke width, and gradient colors
- Automatic scale normalization
- Zero runtime dependencies
